Leah M.: Heads-up: last night we saw ~8% of HubSpot leads not assigned to Salesforce within 30s during the 09:10 UTC spike. Webhook 5xx retries and claim queue piles. Sharing quick mitigation idea.
Javier R.: Any sign enrichment was the culprit?
Leah M.: Yesenrichment had an intermittent 1s TTL bump which exposes our round-robin contention. Example payload (sanitized): `{"email":"redacted@corp.com", "lead_score":81, "utm":"paid"}`
Priya S.: Suggestion: fast-path high-confidence leads by short-circuiting enrichment for assignment. Machine_score >= 75 -> set property `fast_assign` in HS, assign immediately, then async enrich.
Tom B.: Two routes: a quick HubSpot workflow that flags fast_assign + router flag to bypass enrichment (low risk); or infra tune (worker concurrency + jitter) as longer-term. I can add a feature flag and emit assign_latency and assign_fail_rate metrics.
lead-processor-bot: saw 412 retries on /assign between 09:10-09:18 UTC; avg retry delay 350ms.
Javier R.: Sales wants low FP. Let's canary at 5% and monitor misassign rates.
Leah M.: Proposed immediate plan:
- TODAY: Priya create HS workflow to set `fast_assign` when machine_score>=75 and country in {US,CA,EMEA} (5% audience).
- TODAY: Tom implement router flag + metric hooks, enable 5% canary, add PD alert if assign_fail_rate > 2%.
- TOMORROW: 24h canary; Leah/Javier monitor assign_latency, percent-assigned-within-30s, and misassigns.
- CRITERIA: if assign_fail_rate <= baseline +1pp and no sales complaints -> roll to 100% and schedule infra tune.
Priya S.: I'll draft the HS workflow and limit to supported countries to reduce FP.
Tom B.: I'll add Grafana panels and a Slack pulse every 60m for the canary window. PD alert at 2% configured.
Leah M.: Also adding a playbook note: if enrichment backlog > threshold, move fast-assigned leads to an async enrichment queue so main assign path remains unblocked. I'll post the playbook link here once ready.
Javier R.: Thanks team. Keep me posted if we see any increased false assignments.
Leah M.: Thanks aiming to ship before tomorrow morning's peak. :thumbsup:
